card.name: Endings of nursing and dosing terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of nursing-practice words split across tokens, such as titration, cannula, and prn, plus license or practice in nursing settings. It fires where a clinical term is being completed.

modes.label: Titration and prn endings
modes.description: Final piece of up-titration or the abbreviation prn in dosing instructions.
modes.example: Worsening heart failure or fluid retention may occur during up-tit<<ration>> of carvedilol.

modes.label: Cannula and IV line
modes.description: Piece of the word cannula in instructions about flushing or removing an IV line.
modes.example: Flush the intravenous access line or cann<<ula>> with isotonic saline before and after injection

modes.description: Words like license or practice in nursing or clinical-practice phrases.
